_about: Optional one-line descriptions keyed by exact book title. Passed to the model as ground truth so it doesn't confuse books with same-titled ones. Edit freely; changing a note refreshes that book's cached suggestions.
A Parade of Horribles: Dungeon Crawler Carl series (darkly comic LitRPG; Carl and his cat Princess Donut fight through an alien game-show dungeon after Earth is destroyed). Book 8: the tenth floor, a series of vehicle races where finishing last is fatal, after the fallout of the ninth-floor Faction Wars. Then the eleventh floor, a road lined with avatars of dead NPCs called Horribles.
The Eye of the Bedlam Bride: Dungeon Crawler Carl series (darkly comic LitRPG; Carl and his cat Princess Donut fight through an alien game-show dungeon after Earth is destroyed). Book 6: the eighth floor, a map of Earth's final days haunted by intangible ghosts of humanity. Each team must capture six legendary monsters from local Earth lore, which become summonable battle cards. Also features forgotten gods, a breaking-down AI, and an old grudge between a talk show host, an heiress and the man they shattered.
The Gate of the Feral Gods: Dungeon Crawler Carl series (darkly comic LitRPG; Carl and his cat Princess Donut fight through an alien game-show dungeon after Earth is destroyed). Book 4: the fifth floor, split into sealed 'bubbles' with their own ecosystems. Crawlers must clear four quadrants to pop their bubble and reach the stairs.
The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook: Dungeon Crawler Carl series (darkly comic LitRPG; Carl and his cat Princess Donut fight through an alien game-show dungeon after Earth is destroyed). Book 3: the fourth floor, the Iron Tangle, a knotted train and subway network. Carl starts using the guidebook of notes left by past crawlers to push back against the show.
Carl's Doomsday Scenario: Dungeon Crawler Carl series (darkly comic LitRPG; Carl and his cat Princess Donut fight through an alien game-show dungeon after Earth is destroyed). Book 2: the third floor, where Carl and Donut travel with Grimaldi's traveling circus and start to grasp how the show and its sponsors work.
You with the Sad Eyes: Memoir by actor Christina Applegate: growing up as a child actor in Los Angeles, fame, and living with multiple sclerosis.
Storyworthy: Non-fiction by Moth champion Matthew Dicks on finding and telling true personal stories.
The Royal We: Memoir by Roddy Bottum, keyboardist of Faith No More and frontman of Imperial Teen: growing up in Los Angeles, the 80s/90s alternative and metal scene, coming out as gay in that world, and addiction. NOT the royal-romance novel of the same name.
Star Wars: Luke and the Lost Jedi Temple: Star Wars middle-grade adventure: young Luke Skywalker explores an ancient Jedi temple.
Star Wars: Master of Evil: Star Wars novel: Darth Vader's dark quest for forbidden Sith power after the fall of the Republic.
Murder Ballads: Illustrated collection of traditional murder ballads from the British Isles and Appalachia — the dark folk song tradition.
Tearing Down the Orange Curtain: Oral history of Orange County, California punk rock: from Agent Orange, the Adolescents and Social Distortion through The Offspring and No Doubt.
Star Wars: Trials of the Jedi (The High: Star Wars: The High Republic finale — Jedi make a last stand against the Nameless and the Blight.
Star Wars: The Acolyte: Wayseeker: Star Wars: prequel to The Acolyte following Jedi Master Sol and an unorthodox Jedi who walks away from the Order.
Fahrenheit-182: Memoir by Mark Hoppus of blink-182: San Diego skate punk and 90s/2000s pop-punk, fame, and surviving cancer.
Star Wars: The High Republic: Into the L: Star Wars: The High Republic YA novel — young Jedi and friends face the Nameless and creeping darkness.
Star Wars: The High Republic: Haunted St: Star Wars: The High Republic spooky middle-grade story set aboard a haunted space station.
Star Wars: Tempest Breaker (The High Rep: Star Wars: The High Republic full-cast audio drama centered on Marchion Ro, leader of the marauding Nihil.
The Midnight Library: Novel by Matt Haig: between life and death, a woman explores a library of the lives she could have lived — regret, choice and hope.
Greek Mythology: Overview of Greek myths: gods, heroes, monsters and the Trojan War.
Star Wars: Temptation of the Force (The: Star Wars: The High Republic novel — Jedi guard a royal wedding meant to end a war, amid gothic intrigue and the Path of the Open Hand.
It's So Easy: Memoir by Duff McKagan: Seattle punk roots, bassist of Guns N' Roses and Velvet Revolver, addiction and recovery.
Defy the Storm: Star Wars: The High Republic story — Jedi and allies against the Nihil's storms.
Star Wars: The Eye of Darkness (The High: Star Wars: The High Republic novel — the Jedi trapped behind the Nihil's Stormwall and the spreading Blight.
Unleash the Power of Storytelling: Business non-fiction on using stories to persuade and connect in presentations and at work.
